# Skill card

<!-- Generated by tools/catalog.py from each SKILL.md's frontmatter. Do not edit. -->

Thirty-five top-tier-engineer skills, by where the work is. Small changes need none;
for multi-step work, check here first. Load one with the Skill tool by name; a `/command`
is manual-only: suggest it to the user, who types it.

- **Orient:** `arch-map` draw the architecture or what a change does; `code-history` why is it built this way, who decided?; `explain` walk me through how this works; `feature-map` what can this app do, how do I reach X?; `/top-tier-engineer:onboard-system` first time in this codebase, build the whole picture; `project-context` ask the project's memory; `/top-tier-engineer:project-setup` prepare the complete project foundation; `/top-tier-engineer:recall` where were we? resume work
- **Frame:** `problem-framing` vague idea to testable requirements
- **Design:** `agent-design` design an agent's tools before any code; `arch-design` how should this be structured? which stack?; `threat-model` can this be abused?
- **Plan:** `issue-handoff` turn a plan into tracked issues; `plan-work` split work into ordered, checked slices
- **Build:** `agent-evals` evals and a grader before building an agent; `build-discipline` build a multi-file feature in proven slices; `evolve-maintain` upgrade, refactor or deprecate on a live system; `project-update` keep project memory current after work
- **Prove:** `agent-prove` does the agent work, over repeated runs?; `correctness-gate` does it actually work, before merge or release?; `verify-loop` check your own work until it really passes; `wire-check` built, but nothing happens
- **Review:** `latent-audit` dead code and layer violations; `scrutinize` second opinion on a PR, diff or plan; `senior-review` is this codebase good, what is the biggest gap?; `structure-gate` is it spaghetti, measured
- **Fix:** `agent-trace` why did the agent do that?; `debug-protocol` broken and the cause is unknown; `perf-optimize` slow, clunky or expensive
- **Ship:** `agent-release` ship an agent with kill switch and caps; `safe-release` deploy, or change the shape of stored data
- **Watch:** `agent-drift` is the live agent still what we shipped?
- **Run it for me:** `/top-tier-engineer:drive` carry a goal to done, skills chosen for you; `/top-tier-engineer:drive-overnight` the same, unattended, with a morning report; `/top-tier-engineer:pick-skill` unsure which skill fits
